target_audience: Wedding couples, corporate event organizers, brand owners, and graduation graduates in Makassar seeking professional freelance photographers.
emotional_tone: Editorial, trustworthy, artistic, high-end marketplace (Fiverr meets MyWed & Shuttercat)
visual_enhancers: Glassmorphism sticky header with backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/80 dark:bg-zinc-950/80
Subtle grain overlay and 1px refined border highlights
Swipeable MyWed-style large photo gallery grids with lightbox modals
key_features: Homepage marketplace with hero banner, category quick-filters, featured DEMO profiles, and trending packages
Photographer search with advanced filters (category, price range in IDR, rating, Makassar district/location, style)
List and Grid toggle for search results
MyWed-style public photographer profile with swipeable portfolio gallery, bio, packages, and instant booking modal
Fiverr-style standardized service packages with transparent deliverables and timeline
Google OAuth with role-aware protected routes (Customer, Photographer, Admin)
Photographer registration with category selection and encrypted + masked bank account (e.g., BCA •••• 4892)
Internal chat system with live simulated replies from demo photographers
Favorites / Wishlist toggle with persistent storage
Availability calendar with date picker for booking requests
Booking request flow with escrow/deferred payment foundation (payment skipped for demo)
Wallet and demo withdrawal ledger with QRIS/BCA payout simulations
Dashboards for Customer, Photographer, and Admin
Photographer verification status badge & admin audit logs
Commission ledger (e.g., 10% platform fee) & refund records
instructions_to_main_agent: Build a stunning, fully interactive fullstack React application named 'Jasa Kamera' for freelance photography in Makassar. Add data-testid attributes to all interactive elements.
